headline: Fedbank Financial Services CHRO Anila Rajneesh resigns
hook: Leadership change at Fedbank Financial Services
summary: Fedbank Financial Services has announced that Ms. Anila Rajneesh, the Chief Human Resources Officer, is stepping down effective October 09, 2026. The company informed the stock exchanges regarding this upcoming departure at the close of business hours. Senior management exits at non-banking financial companies can occasionally create short-term operational transitions. Indian retail investors holding the stock should monitor future announcements regarding her replacement and leadership continuity.
whats_next: Appointment of a new Chief Human Resources Officer
why_it_matters: Routine senior exit unlikely to impact near-term stock fundamentals.
